summary.text: Steve Hershey is a Republican Maryland state senator from District 36 who has held the seat since October 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
With a background in civil engineering and commercial real estate, he served in the House of Delegates from 2011 to 2013 and is listed as the Senate minority leader.

paragraphs.text: Stephen Hershey Jr. was born in Washington, D.C., on May 2, 1964, and attended Bowie High School.
He earned a B.C.E. in civil engineering from the Catholic University of America in 1987 and an M.B.A. from George Washington University in 2002.
Hershey was a vice president at Trammell Crow Company from 1999 to 2003, held vice president roles at Jones Lang LaSalle and its predecessor from 2006 to 2023, and joined TECfusions in 2023.
He was a delegate to the Republican National Convention in 2012 and 2016.
Hershey served in the Maryland House of Delegates for District 36 from 2011 to 2013.
He assumed office in the state Senate on October 1, 2013.
According to the General Assembly website, he serves on the Executive Nominations, Finance and Rules committees.
Ballotpedia's 2026 elections page lists him as Senate minority leader.
